hypotheses.failureCondition: Reject at the ten-observation futility screen if fewer than two consecutive eligible observations meet both entry thresholds, or if any eligible quote fails the configured route/size checks. Do not interpret passing the screen as acceptance or profit. Preserve the original control and require the seven-day/1,000-observation gate; unknown extra gas, infrastructure, and model invoice costs remain excluded from any full-profit claim.
hypotheses.name: wPONS four-hop size-curve probe
hypotheses.rationale: Hypothesis needing fresh quotes: this WETH → USDG → PONS → wPONS → WETH route could show size-dependent net quote behavior across its supplied exact sizes. SIZE_CURVE must quote every supplied exact size up to 0.005 WETH and select the greatest current after-gas net; it must not scale outputs. Enter only when the selected quote meets the 20 bps edge floor and covers the 15000 bps gas-safety requirement for two consecutive eligible observations. The supplied training data does not validate this forward hypothesis.

hypotheses.failureCondition: Reject at the ten-observation futility screen if fewer than two consecutive eligible observations satisfy both entry thresholds, or if the route cannot produce a valid quote at the specified size. Passing that screen is not acceptance or profit. Keep the original control and require the seven-day/1,000-observation gate; unknown extra gas, infrastructure, and model invoice costs prevent a full-profit claim.
hypotheses.name: wPONS four-hop exact-size edge probe
hypotheses.rationale: Hypothesis needing fresh quotes: the WETH → wPONS → PONS → CASHCAT → WETH route tests a different four-hop pool sequence from the size-curve candidate at the exact supplied 0.005 WETH size. Enter only when its current quote meets the 20 bps edge floor and gas-safety threshold for two consecutive eligible observations. No measured quote for this forward test is claimed here.

limitations: The supplied graph and recent factory discovery are bounded; they do not establish complete chain coverage.
Training observations are not forward validation. Quote opportunities are not fills, trades, inclusion, or earned returns.

QUOTE_IMPROVEMENT is not selected; if used in another experiment, its first source-valid quote cannot signal, and later signals must compare the same size with the previous consecutive source-valid quote.
analysis.summary: The supplied cohort contains six observations and 36 measured quotes, but it does not establish forward performance for any candidate. I propose two bounded paper experiments involving wPONS routes. Both require fresh quotes after publication; neither is a live strategy change. Preserve the original control and apply the existing seven-day and 1,000-observation acceptance gate. A ten-observation screen may reject an unproductive experiment, but passing it is not acceptance or evidence of profit.
